findings.failure_scenario: An ONNX model with a QLinearGlobalAveragePool node whose channels_last attribute is 1 (channels-last layout) previously ran: the old code permuted X to (0,2,3,1) before pooling and returned a quantized result. With the new code the same model raises 'AssertionError: unsure what this does' at op execution time.
findings.summary: QLinearGlobalAveragePool drops support for channels_last=1, which the previous implementation handled, now asserting channels_last == 0 and crashing models that previously worked

findings.failure_scenario: A QLinearConv node with a float32 bias tensor B: conv2d computes int32 accumulation and then ret.add(float32 bias), promoting the output to float32 (mixed int/float binary ops promote to least_upper_dtype in tinygrad). The old code fed this float y through _quantize_linear and produced a correct quantized output; the new code hits 'AssertionError: quantized op should've done math in int' instead.
findings.summary: The new assert dtypes.is_int(out.dtype) in _qlinearop_quantized makes QLinearConv crash on inputs the old code quantized successfully whenever the conv emits a float result (e.g. a float32 bias B)
